#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    cout.tie(0);

    int n, b;
    cin >> n >> b;
    vector<int> arr(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> arr[i];
    }

    if (n & 1) {
        cout << 0;
        return 0;
    }

    vector<int> diffs;
    int ec = 0, oc = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (arr[i] % 2 == 0) ++ec;
        else ++oc;
        if (ec > 0 && oc > 0 && ec == oc) {
            if (i + 1 < n) {
                diffs.push_back(abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1]));
            }
        }
    }

    if (diffs.empty()) {
        cout << 0;
    } else if (diffs.size() == 1) {
        if (diffs[0] <= b) cout << 1;
        else cout << 0;
    } else {
        sort(diffs.begin(), diffs.end());
        int k = 0;
        for (int val : diffs) {
            if (val <= b) {
                b -= val;
                ++k;
            } else break;
        }
        cout << k;
    }

    return 0;
}
